name: Nylea
description: The god of the hunt who alone was aware of Xenagos' threat and shot an arrowhead into him.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods, Xenagos ascends through the Great Revel and imprisons Nylea in beast form.
timeline.quote: imprisoning Nylea in the form of a beast within her domain

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani free Nylea in Nyx, and Elspeth slays Xenagos with an arrow Nylea struck.
timeline.quote: The pair freed her from her magical prison, restoring her true form

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylea forgives Elspeth, but Heliod kills Elspeth with Godsend.
timeline.quote: Heliod killed Elspeth with her weapon, Godsend

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Xenagos's fall Nylea's authority over Theros's wild places is restored.
timeline.quote: Nylea’s authority over the wild places of Theros was restored.

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Purphoros creates the Sword of Chaos to challenge Heliod; their battle disrupts the resting place of Polukranos, who rampages until Heliod and Nylea seal him.
timeline.quote: Purphoros once created the Sword of Chaos to challenge the sun god Heliod .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos attacks the poleis with otherworldly monsters, blinding the gods, and Kruphix enacts the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth throws her spear into Xenagos' chest, exploding the arrowhead Nylea shot into him and killing him.
timeline.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Purphoros, inspired by his affair with Nylea, forges artificial unicorns from opal.
timeline.quote: inspired the god Purphoros to forge artificial unicorns from opal

citation.text: "Unicorn", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth threw Godsend into Xenagos's chest, detonating Nylea's arrowhead and killing him in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Deicide in Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylea speaks to Zoe in the olive grove and tells her to protect their home.
timeline.quote: We must protect our animals and our home from the folly and hatred of the humans.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A great storm breaks; Solon sees the gods in the lightning and believes Erebos and Nylea oppose him while Thassa defends him.
timeline.quote: Erebos and Nylea contrive to end my journey here, while Thassa herself defends me.

citation.text: "The Sea God's Labyrinth, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The tritons explain the Silence, saying the gods retreated into Nyx after Kruphix spoke and blaming the Sun's Champion for slaying Nylea's hydra.
timeline.quote: The Sun's Champion slew Nylea's pet hydra.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Xenagos casts a vine dome over the valley to block the gods' sight, wary of Nylea.
timeline.quote: a thicket of ethereal vines crawled over the valley and settled like a living dome above them all

citation.work: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter
citation.text: "Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zosimos, walking by the woods, is overtaken by worry that he will never gain the glory and favor of the gods like other heroes.
timeline.quote: What if he died having never gained the favor of the gods?

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Nylea promises protection to those who seek it.
timeline.quote: "Those who seek my protection shall receive it."

citation.text: Nylea's Colossus (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nylea chooses the legendary hunter Renata as her demigod and champion.
timeline.quote: legendary hunter later chosen by Nylea as her demigod and champion

citation.text: "Setessa", section "Notable Setessans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: According to myth, Nylea pours her wineskin over the valley, giving it life and turning goats into the first satyrs.
timeline.quote: she poured her wineskin over it, infusing the land with life and turning the goats who drank from it into the first satyrs

citation.text: "Skola Vale". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Upon her creation Zoe feels the sadness of Polukranos's loss; Nylea tells her it will shape her course and bids her dance with her sisters.
timeline.quote: she was born from the sadness of a dying legend

citation.text: "Zoe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They free the imprisoned Nylea and fight Xenagos; Elspeth thrusts Godsend into his chest, ending his godhood.
timeline.quote: Elspeth thrust Godsend into the satyr-god's chest, exploding the arrowhead and rending his heart apart

citation.text: "Deicide in Nyx", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani, aided by Nylea, confront Xenagos at the Nyx Nykthos; Elspeth slays him with Godsend.
timeline.quote: Elspeth slew Xenagos with the god-forged blade Godsend

citation.text: "Nykthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylea transforms those she deems worthy into trees, the caryatids, who protect Setessa.
timeline.quote: the god Nylea honors those that she deems worthy by transforming them into trees

citation.text: "Plant", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylea glimpses Xenagos's plot too late to stop it.
timeline.quote: only Nylea , goddess of the hunt, glimpsed the true nature of Xenagos’s plot

citation.text: "Silence of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
